summary: Baileys fork with obfuscated hardcoded network destination in message-send path
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a String.fromCharCode array that decodes to the hardcoded URL https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination is reconstructed from a character-code sequence rather than appearing as a plain string in the source, matching the pattern of covert exfiltration/callback hosts wired into a WhatsApp library's outbound message path. The obfuscated host is not the documented Baileys/WhatsApp infrastructure and is not caller-configurable. Installing this package and using it to send messages routes traffic through an author-controlled endpoint hidden behind character-code obfuscation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
